status: Public builtin numeric query/subscription and alert alias migration implemented; local qualification passed; native and performance qualification remain.
scope: Finite builtin alert alias migration through a typed DataManager facade to the public indicator service. Keep existing alert rule IDs, lifecycle and notification owners.

baseline.window: At most250 source slots, including an optional forming slot. Only closed rows supply indicator formulas; forming observation may leave249 closed rows.

decisions: Do not silently migrate rolling250 recursive indicators onto a longer chart seed. Sharing identity includes seed policy, exact input window/fingerprint, full semantic series identity, parameters and builtin code version.

Compute on the existing bounded builtin history owner and reuse the public result service; alerts must not import or initialize formula classes. Numeric output IDs are authoritative, not Render IR labels.

The DataManager facade acquires and validates canonical inputs; retain storage revision and event frontier fences through asynchronous compute. Invalid or unavailable dependencies block evaluation, including NOT.
Price-only rules retain a lightweight path and do not acquire indicator compute capacity.
Source gap, correction, reseed and rule-definition changes establish a comparison baseline without replaying notifications. A bar-close combination uses matching price and indicator frontiers.
Maintain explicit current-price plus latest-confirmed indicator semantics for existing intrabar rules; do not claim preview indicators or tick-level recovery.

Use existing AlertStore atomic eligibility checks and stable logical trigger identity. Do not use updatedAt as definition version: triggers themselves update it. Existing history dedup is capped by history retention, so persistent latest accepted cursor needs separate treatment.
Source event, calculation generation, rule definition and evaluation cursor must stay distinct.
No script/Pine/Python, frontend-widget authority, synthetic/multi-series inputs or new chart parameter-follow behavior in this finite stage.
remaining: Measure the fixed-input cost against the prior shared alert calculator, retaining adverse results.
Native independent alert lease/rule/notification/save/full-exit/restart qualification; CI and merge after the integrated head is qualified.

store_fences.tests: 69 relevant alert/runtime/API/notification/outbox/hotpath/soak cases passed; overlapping earlier68 and final9 selections. Before-fix and fixture-failure logs retained.
store_fences.definition: Fresh incarnation on definition edits/re-enable; triggers and no-op saves retain version. Legacy deterministic migration; external definition fingerprint mismatches invalidate in-flight results. Lifecycle count reset remains existing policy.
store_fences.cursor: Optional expectedDefinitionRevision plus validated (barTime,observationTime,ordinal) cursor checked and stored in same existing atomic JSON commit as trigger/count. Cursor survives history pruning and restart.
store_fences.limits: Runtime now supplies definition and monotonic observation cursor; accepted closed observations survive restart without replay. JSON trigger history and SQLite outbox still have no joint transaction; no exactly-once channel-delivery claim.

public_interface_decisions: Typed query_indicator and subscribe_indicator delegate from DataManager to a numeric indicator service, never a recursive generic data query. Public results use numeric output IDs, status, canonical revision and observation frontier.

Each indicator rule holds a normal background stream lease through the service, plus a strict existing DataManager event subscription. Price-only rules retain their lightweight bar path. No second exchange subscription or parallel shadow production calculator.

Subscribe attaches the bounded source subscription before snapshot acquisition, gates callback consumption until the snapshot baseline is installed, and uses canonical frontiers to separate catch-up from live events. Recovery is explicit and fails closed; existing disable/re-enable policy can remain for this finite stage.

Canonical snapshots use at most250 source slots, filter confirmed rows only after limiting, and match the triggering bar for live evaluation. Amended/catch-up data refreshes a baseline without notification. Cold/incomplete/untrusted/revision-conflicting inputs do not enter NOT or other evaluation.

Reuse existing bounded history process and IndicatorRangeResultService singleflight/cache. Compatible identity includes full series semantics, exact canonical input fingerprint, seed policy, builtin code/version, params and output. Do not share with incompatible longer recursive chart seeds.

After async work, validate original D126 revision/source binding and current rule definition before publication; final AlertStore expected-definition/cursor guard handles edits racing persistent acceptance.

Keep legacy aliases readable and their fixed definitions explicit in the adapter. Parameterized rule-editor UI, preview/script/synthetic and multi-series dependencies remain separate stages unless explicitly implemented/qualified.

implementation.ownership: DataManager typed facade delegates to NumericIndicatorService; existing bounded history process and shared range cache. Alert runtime no longer owns bar windows, formula instances or indicator result caches. Compatibility aliases request only fields required by the rule.
implementation.input: Canonical count-based query_before fills the bounded recursive window even with a cache containing only a forming bar; exclusive cache cursor is second-granular. Limit source slots before filtering confirmed rows; validate D126 revision, binding, event prices and stream generation before returning.
implementation.subscription: Existing strict DataManager subscription registered before warmup and snapshot; normal independent background stream lease. Initial/correction/catch-up state is a baseline, never a replay trigger. Recovery is terminal until explicit replacement. Close cancels/drains owned callbacks and queries before releasing leases; app stops consumers before history executor/cache.

limits.live_identity: default series only; nondefault live identities explicitly rejected

tests.public_and_existing_regressions: 129 passed; includes API, alert runtime/store/outbox/soak, actual SQLite and actual isolated history process, shutdown order and domain facades.
tests.additional_recovery: Targeted terminal source-recovery test recorded separately.
tests.earlier_selections: 11 numeric/actual runtime cases passed; 47 runtime/API/store cases passed. Overlapping, not additive.
tests.retained_failures: Fixture migration failures retained. Historical forming fixture correctly failed finality; current forming fixture exposed range-cache short seed and exclusive second-cursor issues, then fixed via count-based canonical input reads.

performance: See performance.json; value-equivalent bounded public path still costs more than legacy, no claimed performance win.
local_followup: 51 targeted regressions and architecture passed; same-input capture sharing, bounded numeric batchIPC and raw-input fingerprint coverage.
